name: interview-assistant-desktop
description: 智能面试学习辅助助手 - Electron 桌面端
appDisplayName: 智能面试学习辅助助手

scripts.dist: npm run build:backend && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:backend: npm run bundle:whisper && python -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --name backend --paths "%CD%\..\backend" --add-data "%CD%\..\backend\assets;assets" --collect-all faster_whisper --collect-submodules faster_whisper --collect-all soundcard --collect-all comtypes "%CD%\..\backend\entrypoint.py" --exclude-module torch --exclude-module tensorflow --exclude-module pandas --exclude-module scipy --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module IPython --exclude-module jedi --exclude-module parso --exclude-module notebook --exclude-module jupyter --exclude-module jupyterlab --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module PyQt5 --exclude-module PySide2 --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module PyInstaller --exclude-module black --exclude-module flake8 --exclude-module ruff --distpath build --workpath build/pyinstaller --specpath build && npm run verify:whisper

author: AI Interview Assistant Contributors
